Keeping bar 19 at medium confidence is right. (b) Pitch of all other events: per-sixteenth agreement with SwiftF0 is SW 484/486 for v3 (v2 477/486) and h4b 471/485 (v2 469/485). The h4b mismatches are 19.10.5 (see a) and transition sixteenths: attack and release edges, the 16.0 approach from C2/C#2, the 21.8 scoop from D2, the 21.10 slide arrival, the late 23.0 and 30.6 entries, and the 23.11 bend before B2.
